tests.name: batch preview shows Zotero language and excludes known Chinese by default
unchecking the option includes Chinese and selecting all still honors the active filter
batch skips identified saved readings, preserves handwritten notes and queues only eligible papers
explicit Chinese opt-in works without interrupting a task already in the queue
admission reads current metadata rather than trusting a stale preview
a queued paper newly marked Chinese is skipped before parsing or model calls
the next batch resets the Chinese default and no paper, language or note is modified by filtering

languageSource: Zotero item language; no inference from titles or notes
scope: Batch admission and execution only; single manual reads and automatic intake unchanged
